facts.business: Prime Capital Market Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in investment and trading in shares and securities, and providing loans and advances.

segments.name: Investment and Trading in Shares & Securities

auditor.name: Rajesh Kumar Gokul Chandra & Associates (now known as SGAJ & Associates)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1. Valuation of unquoted shares inventory at cost pending independent fair valuation (Note 36). 2. Balances of trade receivables, loans/advances, trade payables subject to confirmation (Note 39). 3. No actuarial valuation for employee retirement benefits (Note 28). 4. Non-traded/suspended stocks valued at last traded price (Note 48). 5. Advances against shares of Rs. 165.79 Lakh without interest (Note 49).

key_risks: Valuation uncertainty of unquoted equity shares held as inventory
Unconfirmed balances of trade receivables, loans, advances and payables
Absence of actuarial valuation for employee benefit obligations
Valuation reliance on last traded price for non-traded/suspended securities
Interest-free advances against shares (Rs 165.79 lakh) with recoverability risk
Regulatory penalties (SEBI, SAT, BSE) incurred during the year
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions disclosed in Note 35 include remuneration to KMPs (Adarsh Purohit, Barkha Lakhani, Sneha Agarwal), rent paid to Adarsh Purohit, and loans given to/received from entities like Purohit Construction, Narayani Dealers, Mangalchand Property, Siddhi Vinayak, and Adarsh Purohit HUF.
